data.name: A temporary SSH lease is active
data.value: 目前已有臨時 SSH 租約

data.name: Ask the machine administrator to check SSH setup before requesting or approving a lease.
data.value: 請聯絡機器管理員確認 SSH 設定，準備好後再申請或核准租約。

data.name: Ask the machine administrator to confirm readiness before relying on temporary SSH.
data.value: 需要使用臨時 SSH 時，請先聯絡機器管理員確認機器已準備好。

data.name: Temporary SSH is ready to request
Temporary SSH readiness is awaiting confirmation
data.value: 臨時 SSH 準備狀態待確認

data.name: This machine needs SSH setup
data.value: 這台機器尚未準備好臨時 SSH

data.name: Wait for the current lease to end before requesting another one.
data.value: 請等目前的租約結束後再申請。

data.name: Check the SSH lease history and the Agent version in DMS.
data.value: 請在 DMS 中檢查 SSH 租約歷程記錄和 Agent 版本。

data.name: DMS can check SSH when the Agent reconnects.
data.value: 當 Agent 重新連線時，DMS 可以檢查 SSH。

data.name: DMS has no recent SSH observation
data.value: DMS 沒有最近的 SSH 觀察記錄

data.name: DMS has not verified SSH shutdown
data.value: DMS 尚未驗證 SSH 已關閉

data.name: Ordinary SSH is still listening
data.value: 常規 SSH 仍在接聽

data.name: Review the Disable SSH workflow result in DMS before requesting another lease.
data.value: 在申請另一個租約之前，請先在 DMS 中查看「停用 SSH」工作流程的結果。

data.name: To switch this machine to temporary SSH, run Disable SSH in DMS first.
data.value: 要將此機器切換至臨時 SSH，請先在 DMS 中執行「停用 SSH」。
